trainer_scp.name: Mr. Fuji
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T031 is not to be contained. SCP-T031 may assist in pacifying spectral anomalies such as SCP-0092 (Gastly) and SCP-0094 (Gengar).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T031 displays anomalous empathy toward spectral SCP entities, capable of reducing aggression and stabilizing ectoplasmic behavior. Frequently operates in high-haunting zones.
addendum_logs: Addendum T031-A: SCP-T031 neutralized SCP-0093 (Haunter)’s paralysis field through verbal communication.
Addendum T031-B: Ectoplasmic residue dissipated in SCP-T031’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Silph Co. President
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T032 must not be allowed access to SCP-0137 (Porygon) without Foundation oversight.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T032 oversees development of anomalous technology and has demonstrated partial resistance to psychic manipulation. Maintains high-level knowledge of digital anomalies.
addendum_logs: Addendum T032-A: SCP-T032 resisted SCP-0064 (Kadabra)’s memory distortion attempt.
Addendum T032-B: SCP-T032 provided schematics that improved digital containment efficiency by 14%.

trainer_scp.name: Celadon Game Corner Manager
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid gambling or probability-based interactions with SCP-T033. SCP-T033 must not be allowed near SCP-0100 (Voltorb) due to detonation risk.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T033 displays anomalous manipulation of probability fields, causing unpredictable outcomes in mechanical and digital systems. Effects intensify during emotional stress.
addendum_logs: Addendum T033-A: SCP-T033 caused a 0.0003% probability event to occur during testing.
Addendum T033-B: SCP-0137 (Porygon) displayed corrupted randomization algorithms after SCP-T033’s visit.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Fan Club Chairman
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T034 to emotionally sensitive anomalies such as SCP-0060 (Poliwag).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T034 displays anomalous emotional projection that increases affection and loyalty in nearby anomalies. Effects can escalate into obsessive attachment.
addendum_logs: Addendum T034-A: SCP-0058 (Growlithe) refused to leave SCP-T034’s side for 48 hours.
Addendum T034-B: Emotional projection caused mild euphoria in personnel.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Breeder (Kanto)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T035 may assist in raising juvenile anomalies. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T035 to hostile SCPs.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T035 displays anomalous nurturing influence that accelerates healthy development in juvenile SCP entities. Frequently used in controlled growth programs.
addendum_logs: Addendum T035-A: SCP-0010 (Caterpie) displayed accelerated cocoon formation.
Addendum T035-B: SCP-0066 (Machop) showed reduced aggression in SCP-T035’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Daycare Couple
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T036 must not be allowed access to SCP-0151 (Mew) due to unpredictable reproductive outcomes.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T036 displays anomalous influence over reproductive cycles of SCP entities, enabling cross-species compatibility and accelerated offspring development.
addendum_logs: Addendum T036-A: SCP-T036 facilitated reproduction between two normally incompatible anomalies.
Addendum T036-B: Offspring displayed stable hybrid traits with no mutation.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Move Tutor
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid allowing SCP-T037 to imprint restricted combat techniques onto SCP anomalies.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T037 displays anomalous ability to transfer complex behavioral patterns and combat techniques into SCP entities through verbal instruction and gesture.
addendum_logs: Addendum T037-A: SCP-T037 taught SCP-0025 (Pikachu) a complex maneuver previously considered impossible.
Addendum T037-B: SCP-0068 (Machamp) displayed improved coordination after SCP-T037’s session.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Move Deleter
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T038 must not be allowed near SCP-0097 (Hypno) or SCP-0065 (Alakazam) due to unpredictable psychic feedback.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T038 can selectively suppress or erase learned behaviors in SCP entities. Effects are permanent unless counteracted by SCP-T037.
addendum_logs: Addendum T038-A: SCP-T038 removed SCP-0034 (Nidoking)’s aggressive charge pattern.
Addendum T038-B: SCP-0149 (Dragonite) displayed temporary confusion after memory suppression.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Name Rater
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid allowing SCP-T039 to rename high-threat anomalies.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T039 displays anomalous ability to influence SCP entities through identity resonance. Names assigned by SCP-T039 alter behavioral patterns and emotional stability.
addendum_logs: Addendum T039-A: SCP-T039 renamed SCP-0058 (Growlithe), resulting in increased obedience.
Addendum T039-B: SCP-0126 (Magmar) displayed reduced aggression after identity resonance alignment.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Researcher (Generic)
abilities: rapid adaptation to new SCP data
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T040 may assist in SCP documentation. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T040 to cognitohazardous SCPs.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T040 is a trained anomaly researcher with mild parahuman cognitive enhancement. Displays rapid pattern recognition and behavioral prediction.
addendum_logs: Addendum T040-A: SCP-T040 predicted SCP-0076 (Golem)’s shell detonation 30 seconds before occurrence.
Addendum T040-B: SCP-T040 identified a previously unknown behavioral trigger in SCP-0043 (Oddish).
